metadata.question: Was the surface color of Lake Ijssel near Kornwerderzand visibly greener than near Afsluitdijk on July 8, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake IJssel (Netherlands) near Kornwerderzand and Afsluitdijk - Date: July 8, 2023 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for visual/color analysis (high resolution, good for water color) - Need to compare "greenness" between two locations 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds since we want clear visual assessment - Water mask not strictly needed since we're specifying water locations - Focus on valid pixels for comparison 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Calculate green index or RGB ratios at both locations - Valid comparison: Both locations have valid data → A or B - C1: No images found for the date - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - "Greener" can be assessed using Green/Red ratio or NDVI-like metric for water 4. Approach: - Define two point geometries (Kornwerderzand and Afsluitdijk on Lake IJssel) - Get Sentinel-2 image for July 8, 2023 - Calculate greenness metric (Green band or Green/Red ratio) - Compare values between locations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Kornwerderzand: ~53.075°N, 5.335°E (eastern end of Afsluitdijk) // Afsluitdijk comparison point: ~53.05°N, 5.15°E (middle of causeway) const kornwerderzand = ee.Geometry.Point([5.335, 53.075]); const afsluitdijk = ee.Geometry.Point([5.15, 53.05]); const startDate = '2023-07-08'; const endDate = '2023-07-09'; // 2. Data Acquisition let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(kornwerderzand) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try wider date range collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2023-07-07', '2023-07-10') .filterBounds(kornwerderzand) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size2 = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images with wider range: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log("No images available for the date."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Get best image and mask clouds const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const cloudMask = image.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1024).eq(0) .and(image.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(2048).eq(0)); const maskedImage = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate greenness using Green/Red ratio const greenness = maskedImage.select('B3').divide(maskedImage.select('B4')); // 4. Extract values at both locations const params = { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }; const kornValue = await greenness.reduceRegion({ ...params, geometry: kornwerderzand.buffer(50) }).get('B3').getInfo(); const afsluitValue = await greenness.reduceRegion({ ...params, geometry: afsluitdijk.buffer(50) }).get('B3').getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const kornCount = await maskedImage.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kornwerderzand.buffer(50), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); const afsluitCount = await maskedImage.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: afsluitdijk.buffer(50), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); console.log(`Kornwerderzand: Green/Red=${kornValue?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${kornCount}`); console.log(`Afsluitdijk: Green/Red=${afsluitValue?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${afsluitCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (kornCount === 0 || afsluitCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (kornValue === null || afsluitValue === null || isNaN(kornValue) || isNaN(afsluitValue)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Higher Green/Red ratio = greener if (kornValue > afsluitValue) { console.log("Kornwerderzand was visibly greener."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Kornwerderzand was not greener than Afsluitdijk."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
